title: A Study of Dasatinib With Concurrent Chemoradiation for Stage III Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

sections.abstract:
The purpose of this study is to evaluate if a maximum dose of 100 mg of dasatinib with concurrent chemoradiation can be tolerated in patients with chemotherapy naive stage III NSCLC in separate cohorts of locally advanced and potentially resectable disease.

Posted outcomes: Number of Patients Who Came Off Study for Toxicity Using CTC Version 3.0. timeframe=within 28 days after the last radiation treatment. Group 1=6
